newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Liberty, Sul America in Argentine labor deal.
newsitem.headline: Liberty, Sul America in Argentine labor deal.

text.p: The Argentine labor insurance unit of Liberty Corp has bought the local labor insurance unit of Brazil's largest insurer, Sul America de Seguros, the two companies said Friday.

Ricardo Romanelli, head of Liberty's labor risk insurance arm, which are known in Argentina as ARTs, said the purchase of 100 percent of Sul America's Argentine ART would be signed Friday or next Monday.
The companies said they could not release financial details of the deal.
Romanelli said that at a later stage, the two ARTs would be merged.
Liberty launched on the Argentine ART market two years ago and has 3.0 percent of the ART market, while Sul America has a six percent market share.
"With this purchase we will be third in the market in terms of turnover, and fourth in market share," said the Liberty ART president.
Sul America Director Gaton Geliot confirmed the deal and said his company had 204,000 employees and 14,500 firms on its books. Its biggest business sector is construction, followed by agriculture.
